name: DigitalOcean
description: Typed DigitalOcean cloud resources, guarded mutations, explicit action tracking and bounded monitoring reads.

permissions.description: Calls fixed DigitalOcean HTTPS API with an explicit token secret. Confirmed mutations can create billable resources or delete infrastructure. Alternate tokenSecret names require host authorization. No ambient auth, retries, automatic polling or background listeners.

definitions.name: List Actions
definitions.documentation: List Actions: GET /actions. Uses explicit named ONF secret DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN or tokenSecret; no ambient credentials. Least privilege DigitalOcean endpoint scopes are required. Returns one page (default/max 200), nextPage and optional total; request the next page manually. Never follows provider links. Fixed api.digitalocean.com HTTPS with redirects rejected. Request max 128 KiB, streamed response/result max 1 MiB; timeout 100..30000 ms (default 10000), including secret resolution and reads that ignore abort, then independent 250 ms cancellation cleanup. Known fields are projected and structurally validated; unmodeled extension fields omitted. No live provider validation, subscription listener, Spaces object API, managed database SQL or long-running completion claim. definitions.name: List Regions
definitions.documentation: List Regions: GET /regions. Uses explicit named ONF secret DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN or tokenSecret; no ambient credentials. Least privilege DigitalOcean endpoint scopes are required. Returns one page (default/max 200), nextPage and optional total; request the next page manually. Never follows provider links. Fixed api.digitalocean.com HTTPS with redirects rejected. Request max 128 KiB, streamed response/result max 1 MiB; timeout 100..30000 ms (default 10000), including secret resolution and reads that ignore abort, then independent 250 ms cancellation cleanup. Known fields are projected and structurally validated; unmodeled extension fields omitted. No live provider validation, subscription listener, Spaces object API, managed database SQL or long-running completion claim. definitions.documentation: Get Droplet filesystem size Metrics: GET /monitoring/metrics/droplet/filesystem_size. Uses explicit named ONF secret DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN or tokenSecret; no ambient credentials. Least privilege DigitalOcean endpoint scopes are required. Fixed api.digitalocean.com HTTPS with redirects rejected. Request max 128 KiB, streamed response/result max 1 MiB; timeout 100..30000 ms (default 10000), including secret resolution and reads that ignore abort, then independent 250 ms cancellation cleanup. Known fields are projected and structurally validated; unmodeled extension fields omitted. No live provider validation, subscription listener, Spaces object API, managed database SQL or long-running completion claim.
